references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.75 para 2
references.quote: A temporary cessation of all or part of the business for a cause other than force majeure pays at least 75 percent of the working-day wage for the whole period.

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.75 para 1
references.quote: Force majeure suspends the employer's duty to pay wages for a working day not worked.

description: A force-majeure event that stops work; pay follows the agreed stoppage terms.
